task.title: Signalpost company research
task.summary: Build an agent that finds company information online.
task.problem: Give it a Norwegian company number. It searches permitted public sources and returns a company profile with facts, source links and dates.
task.scoring: 100 points: information found 35, correct facts and sources 30, updates and new sources 20, useful summaries 10, ease of use 5. Community voting is separate.
task.how_to_enter: Read this challenge’s input, output, scoring and submission requirements. Use its starter files, test your program, and submit the required repository, files or supported endpoint through the stated route. Task feeds do not accept submissions or pay prizes automatically.
task.eval: Use this challenge’s stated test and submission instructions; no submission or payment API.

spec.name: Build a company research agent
spec.requirements: Build an agent that researches the right company, links facts to sources, and checks for changes. Use the public list of 411,160 companies; submit at least 1,000 profiles. We test 100 randomly selected companies each day.
spec.task: Turn an organisation number into a useful profile: resolve the public identity, collect permitted official and public evidence, answer supported questions, and detect changes without overwriting history.

interface.output: one completed company record with a source for each fact, explicit missing-data labels, and update timestamps

reward.split: $2,000 main pool ($1,200/$500/$300) plus $500 JBOX bonus ($250/$150/$100); four $100 community-vote awards are separate.
reward.benchmark: The published qualification bar and locked evaluator fixture.

constraints.public_fixture: 411,160 Norway-registered entities with observed 2025 annual-account records; minimum 1,000 submitted profiles; 100-company product sample
constraints.hidden_tests: the same 100 companies randomly selected after the daily cutoff for every submitted agent version on each scheduled test day
constraints.network: 45 minutes; 8 vCPU; 16 GB RAM; 10 GB disk; 2,000 requests; $10 third-party API budget per 100-company batch
constraints.missing_data: show not available; never convert missing values to zero

spec.scoring: 100 points: coverage and source discovery 35; accuracy, exact identity and evidence 30; refresh and extensibility 20; decision-useful synthesis 10; UX and interaction 5. External coverage is 70% company recall and 30% claim recall against the cumulative verified union; every entrant is rescored whenever that union expands. Qualification requires 65 overall, 21/35 coverage, 60% weighted external company recall, 95% external precision and all hard gates. Public voting never changes technical ranking.

methods.instructions: Email a public repository URL or private access path, the run command, models/APIs used, and the expected cost per scored run.
